blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Seventeen people have died of dengue-related complications in Negros Occidental and Bacolod City this year, including 11 deaths reported by the Provincial Health Office (PHO) in the province and five in Bacolod City. The PHO report released Thursday did not yet include the death of an 11-year-old boy who succumbed to dengue in Silay City on Sept. 15, as reported by the Silay City Health Office. Despite the deaths, Negros Occidental recorded a 38.22-percent decline in dengue cases from Jan. 4 to Sept. 15, with 2,889 cases compared with 4,676 during the same period last year.
